body:
I don't think the engine is designed for you to manually trigger a system-initiated notification like `NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST`, since the window is not actually being closed when you trigger this notification so various assumptions that are being made about the state/intent of the system at that point would be incorrect.

The correct way to refactor code like this would be along the lines of:

```gdscript
extends Control

func prompt_save() -> void:
	var cd = ConfirmationDialog.new()
	cd.get_ok_button().pressed.connect(func(): get_tree().quit())
	cd.popup_exclusive_centered(self)

func _ready() -> void:
	get_tree().set_auto_accept_quit(false)
	$Button.pressed.connect(func(): prompt_save())
	# or
	# $Button.pressed.connect(prompt_save)

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if (what == NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST):
		prompt_save()
```

which retains your code reuse but does not trigger an event that may have other effects on code that listens to it.

I believe this can be closed as intended behaviour, cc @AThousandShips
